product.title: Private Doors-Off Kauai Helicopter: Ultimate Waterfalls & Canyons

description.text: On Kauai, the excitement of a helicopter tour can quickly turn to disappointment when you are seated in the middle. Not on this private tour where every seat is a window seat. Stops include Manawaiopuna Falls, Olokele Canyon, Waimea Canyon, Na Pali Coast, Wai'ale'ale Crater. You'll get excellent views of Kauai as you soar through the sky over Manawaiopuna Falls, the Olokele Canyon, Waimea Canyon, Na Pali coast, and Wai'ale'ale crater. Ideal for visitors basing on Kauai who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
